title: Spec under camouflage
prompt:
A 'text conditioner' applies two rules in order: (1) if the text is shorter than 3 characters (or null), return it unchanged; (2) otherwise return only its **middle two** characters (for even length, the two straddling the center; for odd length, the center character plus the one after it). Implement `process(String s)`.

Examples: `"code"` → `"od"`, `"abc"` → `"bc"`, `"ab"` → `"ab"`, `"x"` → `"x"`.

tests.name: middle extraction
tests.hint: Guard the short/null case first; the left index of the pair is (s.length()-1)/2 for both parities.
